answer: Audits are recorded in echo, queued in signal, and canyon publishes the wait time. A farm of 183 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 54 identities per epoch. A farm of 1332 identities would post 4697 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
